mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production constraints and reduced output.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is growing at less than 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary policy overshoot, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which historically correlates with increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a strong supply side and economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.
